feature: Small items 2, item 8: quick-add's failed search says so in the shared deck toast, with Try again, lifted 10px above the quick-add dock
note: Run against a deck the signed-in account owns (QAF_DECK). The search is a Server Action POSTed to the deck's own URL, so the failure is forced by mocking that URL with a 500 AFTER the page has loaded; the toast is portalled to the body, outside `main`, so the rows settle rather than wait on it. The page is reused across rows, so each row unroutes its mock last.

shares.note: The deck slot's toast frame, the one the got-it receipt draws. The failed-search toast renders it as-is (placement "deck"), never a copy of its look.

rows.label: /decks/[id]: a quick-add search that failed. The toast sits 10px above the dock; the field keeps "sw" and focus, no list opens
/decks/[id]: the same failure, then a search that lands (typing on). The toast is gone and the list opens
